BrownChainedPlat.name: Brown chained platform main
summary: Sprite 5F: a platform on a chain that swings around a pivot like a pendulum. Angle is [$1528,X]:[$151C,X] ($0000-$01FF),
swing speed is [$1504,X], [$1602,X] = Mario standing on it, [$160E,X] = Mario touching it.
Each frame: damps the speed when nobody stands on it, computes the platform position from the (mirrored) angle, draws the chain
(6 links) and the platform (4 tiles, 10 OAM slots), then advances the angle and handles Mario riding it (pumps the swing, carries him).

BrwnChainPlatTiles.name: Table: platform tiles, then off-screen Y check
summary: The tile table ($60,$61,$61,$62) is followed by CODE_01C9BF: sets carry if the 16-bit Y in [$09] is off-screen vertically.
Parameters: [$09]-[$0A]: world Y. Returns: carry set if off-screen.

s01C9D6.name: Table: swing speed steps and limits
summary: $01C9D6: speed step per half of the swing (+1,-1). $01C9D8: matching maximum speed (+$40,-$40).

s01C9DA.name: Platform: Mario interaction and geometry helpers
summary: $01C9DA: clears the Mario contact flag and updates Mario after riding. $01C9EC: Mario touch/stand test, carries Mario with the platform
and pumps the swing speed up to +/-$40. $01CA9C: platform contact box. $01CACB: pivot from sprite position. $01CB20: sine/cosine lookup
from CircleCoords. $01CB53: rotates the radius vector by the angle. $01CC28: 16x16 multiply (via the hardware multiplier) into [$04]-[$07].

DoNothing.name: Delay, Mode 7 rotated tile check, helpers
summary: DoNothing: 8 NOPs + RTS, a delay for the hardware multiplier/divider. $01CC9D: long routine, probably for the Mode 7 boss room: rotates the point
[$14B4]/[$14B6] by angle [$36] around the Mode 7 center ([$2A],[$2C]) and returns carry set if the tile at $0AF6 is >= $15 (solid).
$01CCEC: negate A. $01CCF0: advance the swing angle by speed/16 with a fractional accumulator [$1510,X].

PipeKoopaKids.name: Pipe-room Koopa kid main routine
summary: Sprite main routine for the two Koopa kid entries after Lemmy/Wendy in the pointer table; calls the shared code in bank 3 (CODE_03CC09).
